title: Publish terminal gate prices daily (fuel wholesalers)
what: A wholesale supplier of declared petroleum products must make its terminal gate prices available each day, on a public website.

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Codes—Oil) Regulations 2017
sources.quote: 9 Disclosing terminal gate price (1) A wholesale supplier must, on each day: (a) make available the terminal gate prices the wholesale supplier charges on that day for the wholesale sale of each declared petroleum product the wholesale supplier sells; and (b) do so on a publicly accessible website.

reach.condition: if it sells declared petroleum products at wholesale
